description: Measured equivalences between fast-lane source files. Each entry says a file's new sha256 computes byte-identically to an earlier one; the lane identity hashes the earliest. Append-only. A change that moves any feature byte gets no entry.

equivalences.evidence: Old source 3ba9794 against the new, on 8x B200: the vLLM install check decided identical at 3b, 8b and 70b under unchanged lane ids; reduce_capture gave byte-identical vectors on 64 captured 70B rows (32 native, 32 null); the fast lane gave byte-identical vectors on 8 70B rows with its lane id unchanged; the 128-row spec70 bank of a 70B extension lane, re-banked through the new source after its install check decided identical, was array_equal on 128 of 128 rows under its unchanged lane id; and tests/test_gate_topk_equivalence.py holds the gate top-k equal to its earlier form on tie-forced surfaces.
